research.title: Conformal Prediction under Covariate Shift
bullets: Designed controlled experiments comparing standard and importance-weighted conformal prediction under covariate shifts in synthetic regression datasets.
Analyzed empirical coverage and interval width across shift conditions, examining sensitivity to density-ratio estimation and calibration sample composition.

research.title: Probability Calibration under Class Imbalance
bullets: Designed experiments comparing temperature scaling, isotonic regression, and uncalibrated classifiers across controlled class imbalance conditions and held-out evaluation sets.
Analyzed reliability diagrams, Brier scores, and class-conditional calibration errors to distinguish calibration effects from changes in discrimination and class prevalence.

publications.title: Class Imbalance and Post-Hoc Probability Calibration: An Empirical Comparison of Temperature Scaling and Isotonic Regression

work.title: Batch Data Validation and Processing
bullets: Implemented Python routines for validating incoming tabular records, handling missing fields, and producing consistent outputs for downstream application components.
Added regression tests for malformed inputs and revised error handling to support diagnosis of failed batch processing jobs.

projects.title: Regularized Regression with Correlated Predictors
bullets: Implemented ridge and lasso regression workflows with standardized predictors, nested cross-validation, and synthetic datasets containing correlated features.
Compared predictive error and coefficient stability across regularization settings, examining how predictor correlation affected variable selection and estimation variability.

projects.title: Approximate Inference for Bayesian Logistic Regression
bullets: Implemented Laplace approximation and mean-field variational inference for Bayesian logistic regression using shared likelihood definitions and matched prior settings.
Compared posterior summaries, predictive log loss, and optimization behavior on synthetic classification datasets with varying sample sizes and feature dependence.

projects.title: Kernel Methods for Nonlinear Regression
bullets: Implemented kernel ridge regression and Gaussian process regression with radial basis kernels, using common preprocessing and validation splits.
Compared held-out prediction errors and computational demands across kernel settings, inspecting residual patterns for misspecification on nonlinear regression tasks.

projects.title: Bootstrap Confidence Intervals for Skewed Data
bullets: Implemented percentile, basic, and bias-corrected bootstrap intervals for estimating population means from simulated skewed and heavy-tailed distributions.
Compared empirical coverage and interval lengths across sampling conditions, documenting sensitivity to extreme observations and the number of bootstrap resamples.
